[SPEC] DW Core is the server component of the wallet and is declared a fully trusted part of it (VCVP design decision)
the app calls only DW Core , DW Core makes every protocol call , the app signs and encrypts , DW Core checks the verifier (TC-1) for the wallet
[STANDARD] OpenID4VP 1.0
• 15.1 (SHOULD NOT) transaction history accessible to others
• 15.2 (SHOULD) privacy notice available
[SPEC] DW Core sees the verifier , the time and the requested claims in the request object , never the VP
